builtBy: pnpm fetch-club-rosters:volleyball (scripts/fetch-club-rosters-ncva.mjs): the public team rosters of the NCVA Girls Power League, read from TM2Sign's public API (the NCVA's own event system). clubSlugs is kept by hand and carried over.
notes: A kept copy of the public team rosters of the NCVA Girls Power League (USA Volleyball's Northern California region), so a high school roster can be compared with them (pnpm compare-club-rosters:volleyball) without reading the league's pages again. Never rendered: it names players who are on no tracked roster.

A TM2Sign roster gives each player's first and last name and jersey, and nothing else: no class year, position or school. A team is compared on the classes its age group admits (classYears; USA Volleyball's July 1 age definition and California's September 1 school cutoff), so a player playing up on an older team is never matched.

Kept per player: first and last name. Not kept: jerseys, staff, and the 2026 league's 18s and the 2027 league's 13s and younger, which hold no player in high school in 2026-27 (a 13s team of the 2026 league holds the class of 2030 born in July or August 2012 only).
2026 NCVA Girls Power League (the 2025-26 club season): 591 teams read on 2026-11-27, 579 listing players.
2027 NCVA Girls Power League (the 2026-27 club season): 594 teams read on 2026-11-27, 42 listing players.
